title: Census Bureau: Business AI use, December 2025–May 2026
excerpt: overall AI usage hovered between 17% and 20%
segment: Businesses using AI in any business function
finding: Census reports business AI use around 17–20% during the survey period.
limitation: Broad adoption proxy, not agent-tool revenue, willingness to pay, or a current October estimate. November 2025 question wording changed; do not compare directly with earlier series.

title: CMS: Historical National Health Expenditures
excerpt: U.S. health care spending grew 7.2 percent in 2024, reaching $5.3 trillion or $15,474 per person.
finding: Total US healthcare spending reached $5.3 trillion in 2024, up 7.2% in nominal terms.
limitation: Broad expenditure context, not medical-device, rehabilitation, assistive-tech or software TAM. Nominal spending growth does not establish volume growth or available product budgets.

title: BLS: Home Health and Personal Care Aides
excerpt: Employment of home health and personal care aides is projected to grow 18 percent from 2025 to 2035
segment: Home health and personal care aide employment
finding: BLS projects 18% employment growth for home health and personal care aides over 2025–2035.
limitation: An occupational forecast indicating care demand; it does not prove a labor shortage, automation savings, reimbursement or demand for a specific device.

title: DOE: Data Center Resource Hub, 2025 report update
excerpt: data centers could account for 11.8% of total U.S. electricity use by the end of the decade
finding: DOE cites LBNL's central forecast of 11.8% of US electricity use by 2030 for data centers.
limitation: Scenario-based demand projection, not software-market revenue or buyer ROI. Equipment-shipment modeling does not directly model future grid or on-site supply; efficiency may change outcomes.

title: IFR: Five Million Robots Now Operate in Factories Globally
excerpt: The global operational stock of industrial robots surged 9% to a record 5 million units in 2025.
finding: IFR reports industrial robot stock of 5 million in 2025, up 9% year over year.
limitation: Industry association statistics on installed stock, not revenue, annual shipments or demand for a particular component. Geographic and application-level growth can differ.
